maker: EVS TECH CO., LTD (EVST, formerly EVS Robotics)
name: EVST Mobile Manipulator EVST-Alpha
summary: A six-axis collaborative arm (20 kg, 1700 mm) on a laser-SLAM differential-drive base with 400 kg chassis payload, sold by EVST of Chengdu for loading and unloading several CNC machines in turn; vision brings the arm to about ±0.1 mm at each stop.

germany.statusNote: EVST (Chengdu, China) has German-language product pages and quotes per project after a feasibility check (sales@evsrobot.com), but names no EU office, distributor or reseller.

specs.label: Arm payload
specs.conditions: standard six-axis collaborative arm, 1700 mm reach
specs.quote: einen 20 kg / 1700 mm langen sechsachsigen kollaborativen Arm

specs.label: Chassis payload
specs.conditions: standard chassis, includes arm, fixture, grippers and parts; EVST-Gamma up to 1000 kg

specs.label: Base dimensions (L x W x H)
specs.quote: eine 1150 × 800 × 760 mm große Differentialantriebsbasis mit Laser-SLAM-Navigation

specs.label: Rated runtime
specs.conditions: 48 V LiFePO4; full charge 5-100 % up to 2 h at the automatic charging station

specs.label: Arm positioning after vision correction
specs.conditions: ±; the base itself parks to ±10 mm and ±1°
specs.quote: die Basis parkt auf ±10 mm und ±1° genau, eine zweistufige Bildverarbeitung bringt den Arm dann an jeder Maschine auf ±0.1 mm genau

specs.label: Floor requirement
specs.value: Unevenness below 3 mm per m², slope below 0.05 (below 0.01 at docking points), steps below 5 mm
specs.quote: Boden: Unebenheiten unter 3 mm pro m²

specs.label: Scope of delivery
specs.value: Mobile platform, arm and grippers, vision, control and electrical systems, dispatch software and project-specific stations
specs.quote: EVST liefert den mobilen Manipulator als definierten Leistungsumfang: mobile Plattform, Arm und Greifer

notes: Pneumatic contoured grippers or vacuum cups with a tool changer are part of the standard scope.
Sister series on the same platform: EVST-Beta (precision parts, force-controlled placing) and EVST-Gamma (bin transfer, chassis up to 1000 kg).
Needs flat, dry, clean indoor floors and Wi-Fi along the route.
